note: Each defect is planted inside the section with its id. An inspector finding is a true positive when its check matches and it names an element inside that section, or the file given as the defect's resource.

defects.title: Spacing off the scale
defects.planted: 13 px padding above and below the text. The scale has 12 and 16.
defects.fixedInTwin: The padding is 12 px above and below, from the scale.

defects.title: Compounded type size
defects.planted: 0.875em inside a 0.875rem parent, which renders at 12.25 px.
defects.fixedInTwin: The note is set in rem, so it renders at 14 px, a step of the scale.

defects.title: Near-miss edge
defects.planted: the next line starts 2 px to the right of the text above it.
defects.fixedInTwin: The next line shares the left edge of the text above it.

defects.title: Unequal sibling gaps
defects.planted: the third item has an extra 8 px top margin, so the gaps run 8, 16, 8.
defects.fixedInTwin: All four items are 8 px apart.

defects.title: Radius off the set
defects.planted: a 6 px radius. The set is 4 and 12.
defects.fixedInTwin: A 4 px radius, from the set.

defects.title: Non-concentric corners
defects.planted: the inner box keeps the outer 12 px radius inside a 4 px inset; concentric is 8 px.
defects.fixedInTwin: The inner radius is 12 minus 4, so 8 px.

defects.title: Font fallback
defects.planted: the first family points at a file that does not exist, so the text falls back to a platform font.
defects.css:
@font-face { font-family: "Fixture Missing"; src: url("missing-font.woff2") format("woff2"); }
.d07 { font-family: "Fixture Missing", sans-serif; }
defects.fixedInTwin: The text is set in the loaded web font.

defects.title: Contrast against rendered pixels
defects.planted: white text over a light raster image. Its computed background is transparent, so only the rendered pixels show the problem.
defects.fixedInTwin: Dark text over the same light raster image.

defects.title: Target size
defects.planted: two 18 px icon buttons 4 px apart.
defects.fixedInTwin: Two 44 px icon buttons 8 px apart.

defects.title: Page overflow at a narrow width
defects.planted: a box with a 336 px minimum width. At 320 px the page scrolls sideways; from 360 px it fits.
defects.fixedInTwin: The box is never wider than its column.

defects.title: Text spilling out of its box
defects.planted: a long word that cannot break, in a 96 px box.
defects.fixedInTwin: The long word is allowed to break.

defects.title: Clipping at 200% text
defects.planted: a fixed 40 px height with overflow hidden. The text fits at the default text size and is cut off when the browser text size is doubled.
defects.fixedInTwin: A 40 px minimum height, so the box grows with the text.

defects.title: Overlapping text
defects.planted: a caption positioned 8 px down, over the line above it.
defects.fixedInTwin: The caption sits below the line, 8 px apart.

defects.title: Form control font
defects.planted: an empty text field left with the browser's own control font.
defects.fixedInTwin: The field inherits the page font.

defects.title: Hairline off the pixel grid
defects.planted: a 1 px rule moved down half a pixel.
defects.fixedInTwin: The rule sits on a whole pixel.

defects.title: Undeclared fluid size
defects.planted: a lead paragraph set with clamp() from 16 to 18 px, a range the system does not declare. The h1 on both pages is fluid too, but declared, so it must not be reported.
defects.fixedInTwin: The lead is set at 16 px.

defects.title: Text locked in px
defects.planted: a caption set at 14px, which stays 14 px when the reader doubles the browser text size.
defects.fixedInTwin: The caption is set at 0.875rem, so it follows the setting.

defects.title: Two steps at one size
defects.planted: a label at the body size with a 22 px line height. The system has two 16 px steps, body at 24 px and label at 20 px, so it fits neither.
defects.fixedInTwin: The label is set 16/20 at weight 600, the label step. It shares its size with the body step, so it must be matched by its line height as well.

defects.title: Failed request
defects.planted: the figure draws from d19-missing.json, which does not exist. The page catches the 404 and shows a message in its place, so no script error is raised.
defects.fixedInTwin: The figure draws from d19-data.json, which exists.

defects.title: Drawn after measuring
defects.planted: the figure draws 2.5 s after the load event, by which time the inspector has begun measuring.
defects.fixedInTwin: The figure draws as the page is read, before the load event.
